prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Miami FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for all of Miami—the right choice depends heavily on your neighborhood, property type, and price range. Based on the available rankings and review data, **Sandra Rathe of REAL** is one candidate to interview: HomeLight lists her first among its Miami agents, with a 5.0 rating and 132 reviews. That ranking is a starting point, not a guarantee of the best result for your home.

I’d interview **three agents who have recently sold homes similar to yours in your specific neighborhood**. Ask each for:
- Recent comparable listings they personally handled, including sale price versus asking price and time on market
- Their pricing strategy and a written marketing plan
- Their commission and contract terms
- References from recent sellers

You can also compare local agents through [HomeLight’s Miami directory](https://www.homelight.com/miami-fl/top-real-estate-agents) and [Zillow’s Miami agent directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/miami-fl/). If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, property type, and approximate price range, I can help narrow down what to look for.
